against.text: Earnings gap: worst observed would cost -9.0% of the position, about 1,795 USDT at this size. worst of 4 past earnings reactions.
The simulation puts the chance of losing more than 5% at 5%, with an expected shortfall of -6.7% in the worst twentieth.
One time in twenty, moments like this lost 4.0% or more over the horizon, about 792 USDT. When it did go past that, the average was -4.6%, on 2 episodes.
Getting out costs 15 bps on the live book, about 30 USDT, before any adverse move.
The resemblance may be doing nothing: against random hours of the same kind the difference in mean outcome is -0.24% with p = 0.53.
In the recorded archive the book could not absorb this size within budget 30% of the time during weekend.
3 of the recalled past calls in conditions like these finished below the level they were sized against.
Only 45% of those moments ended positive, on 40 episodes.

supporting.text: Up to 50,000 USDT this is a straight go.
A full perp hedge costs 12 bps, which buys out most of the price risk if you want the position anyway.
